audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Temple destruction, communal catastrophe, enemy violence, creation, sea monsters, and lament.

verses.restored: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

familiar.text: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

modern.text: Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?

original.text: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף לָמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָנֶ֑צַח יֶעְשַׁ֥ן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ בְּצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

familiar.text: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

modern.text: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance— Mount Zion where You dwell.

original.text: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְךָ֨ קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ הַר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Lift up thy feet to the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

familiar.text: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

modern.text: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.

original.text: הָרִ֣ימָה פְ֭עָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁא֣וֹת נֶ֑צַח כָּל הֵרַ֖ע אוֹיֵ֣ב בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

familiar.text: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

modern.text: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,

original.text: שָׁאֲג֣וּ צֹ֭רְרֶיךָ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣ם אֹתֽוֹת

verses.restored: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

familiar.text: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

modern.text: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees

original.text: יִ֭וָּדַע כְּמֵבִ֣יא לְמָ֑עְלָה בִּֽסֲבָךְ עֵ֝֗ץ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת

verses.restored: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

familiar.text: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

modern.text: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.

original.text: ועת פִּתּוּחֶ֣יהָ יָּ֑חַד בְּכַשִּׁ֥יל וְ֝כֵֽילַפֹּ֗ת יַהֲלֹמֽוּן

verses.restored: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

familiar.text: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

modern.text: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.

original.text: שִׁלְח֣וּ בָ֭אֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑ךָ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ חִלְּל֥וּ מִֽשְׁכַּן שְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

familiar.text: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

modern.text: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.

original.text: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כָל מוֹעֲדֵי אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

familiar.text: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

modern.text: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.

original.text: אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֥א רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ אֵֽין ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא וְלֹֽא אִ֝תָּ֗נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד מָֽה

verses.restored: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

familiar.text: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

modern.text: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?

original.text: עַד מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְךָ֣ לָנֶֽצַח

verses.restored: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

familiar.text: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

modern.text: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!

original.text: לָ֤מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְךָ וִֽימִינֶ֑ךָ מִקֶּ֖רֶב חוקך כַלֵּֽה

verses.restored: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

familiar.text: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

modern.text: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.

original.text: וֵ֭אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣י מִקֶּ֑דֶם פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

familiar.text: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

notes.title: Sea monsters and Leviathan
notes.body: The poem uses ancient chaos-combat imagery involving sea creatures and Leviathan. This is mythopoetic language, not zoology or a command to identify human enemies with monsters.

modern.text: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;

original.text: אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֣ יָ֑ם שִׁבַּ֖רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל הַמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; you gave him as food to creatures of the wilderness.

familiar.text: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

modern.text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.

original.text: אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן תִּתְּנֶ֥נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְעָ֣ם לְצִיִּֽים

verses.restored: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

familiar.text: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

modern.text: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

original.text: אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָנָ֑חַל אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ נַהֲר֥וֹת אֵיתָֽן

verses.restored: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

familiar.text: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

modern.text: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.

original.text: לְךָ֣ י֭וֹם אַף לְךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ

verses.restored: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

familiar.text: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

modern.text: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.

original.text: אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כָּל גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ קַ֥יִץ וָ֝חֹ֗רֶף אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּם

verses.restored: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O YHWH, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

familiar.text: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

modern.text: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.

original.text: זְכָר זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף יְהוָ֑ה וְעַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִֽאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove to the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

familiar.text: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

modern.text: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.

original.text: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ךָ חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗יךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח

verses.restored: Have respect to the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

familiar.text: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

modern.text: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

original.text: הַבֵּ֥ט לַבְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס

verses.restored: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

familiar.text: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

modern.text: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.

original.text: אַל יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

familiar.text: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

modern.text: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.

original.text: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣ה רִיבֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְךָ֥ מִנִּי נָ֝בָ֗ל כָּל הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

familiar.text: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

modern.text: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.

original.text: אַל תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑יךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗יךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Sacred-site destruction and enemy language must not justify retaliation against modern religions, ethnicities, or civilians.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
